verses.geez: ኩን፡ ዐርከ፡ እምትኩን፡ ጸላዔ፡ እስመ፡ ደኃሪቱ፡ ለስም፡ እኩይ፡ ኀሣር፡ ወጽዕለት፡ ወከማሁ፡ ኃጥእኒ፡ ዘክልኤ፡ ልሳኑ።
verses.translation: Instead of a friend become not an enemy; for [thereby] thou shalt inherit an ill name, shame, and reproach: even so shall a sinner that hath a double tongue.

translations.ron: Să nu te faci vrăjmaş în loc de prieten, că numele rău ruşine şi ocară va moşteni; aşa este păcătosul cel cu două limbi.

verses.geez: ወኢታዕቢ፡ ርእሰከ፡ በምክረ፡ ነፍስከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይምሥጥዋ፡ ከመ፡ ላህም፡ ለነፍስከ።
verses.translation: Extol not thyself in the counsel of thine own heart: that thy soul be not torn in pieces as a bull [straying alone].

translations.lxx: Extol not thyself in the counsel of thine own heart: that thy soul be not torn in pieces as a bull [straying alone].
translations.ron: Nu te lăsa în voia patimilor tale, ca să nu fii târât de ele ca de un taur furios.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀντὶ φίλου μὴ γίνου ἐχθρός· ὄνομα γὰρ πονηρὸν αἰσχύνην καὶ ὄνειδος κληρονομήσει· οὕτως ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς ὁ δίγλωσσος. Μὴ ἐπάρῃς σεαυτὸν ἐν βουλῇ ψυχῆς σου, ἵνα μὴ διαρπαγῇ ὡς ταῦρος ἡ ψυχή σου.

verses.geez: ወቈፅለከኒ፡ ይበልዐከ፡ ወተሀጕል፡ ፍሬከ፡ ወከመ፡ ዕፅ፡ ይቡስ፡ የኀድገከ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt eat up thy leaves, and lose thy fruit, and leave thyself as a dry tree.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt eat up thy leaves, and lose thy fruit, and leave thyself as a dry tree.
translations.ron: Altfel frunzele tale vei mânca şi roadele tale vei pierde şi vei rămâne ca un lemn uscat.
translations.grk: Τὰ φύλλα σου καταφάγεσαι, καὶ τοὺς καρπούς σου ἀπολέσεις, καὶ ἀφήσεις σεαυτὸν ὡς ξύλον ξηρόν.

verses.geez: ነፍስ፡ ጸዋግ፡ ተሀጕሎ፡ ለዘአጥረያ፡ ወትሬስዮ፡ ጥቡዐ፡ ለጸላዒሁ።
verses.translation: A wicked soul shall destroy him that hath it, and shall make him to be laughed to scorn of his enemies.

translations.lxx: A wicked soul shall destroy him that hath it, and shall make him to be laughed to scorn of his enemies.
translations.ron: Sufletul rău va pierde pe cel ce-l are pe el şi va face bucurie vrăjmaşilor.
translations.grk: Ψυχὴ πονηρὰ ἀπολεῖ τὸν κτησάμενον αὐτήν, καὶ ἐπίχαρμα ἐχθρῶν ποιήσει αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ልሳን፡ ጥዑም፡ ያበዝኅ፡ ታአኃሁ፡ ወአፍ፡ ጥዑም፡ ያበዝኅ፡ ማኅፈሮ።
verses.translation: Sweet language will multiply friends: and a fairspeaking tongue will increase kind greetings.

translations.lxx: Sweet language will multiply friends: and a fairspeaking tongue will increase kind greetings.
translations.ron: Graiul dulce înmulţeşte pe prieteni şi limba cea binegrăitoare îndatorează, deseori, la răspunsuri binevoitoare.
translations.grk: Λάρυγξ γλυκὺς πληθυνεῖ φίλους αὐτοῦ, καὶ γλῶσσα εὔλαλος πληθυνεῖ εὐπροσήγορα.

verses.geez: ብዙኃን፡ ይከውኑከ፡ አዕርክተ፡ ወአሐዱ፡ እምእልፍ፡ ምስለ፡ ዘትትናገር፡ ምክረከ።
verses.translation: Be in peace with many: nevertheless have but one counsellor of a thousand.

translations.lxx: Be in peace with many: nevertheless have but one counsellor of a thousand.
translations.ron: Mulţi să fie cei ce trăiesc în pace cu tine, iar sfetnicii tăi să fie dintr-o mie unul.
translations.grk: Οἱ εἰρηνεύοντές σοι ἔστωσαν πολλοὶ, οἱ δὲ σύμβουλοί σου εἷς ἀπὸ χιλίων.

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ትትዐረክ፡ ዐርከ፡ ተዐረክ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ተጽናስከ፡ ወኢትትአመኖ፡ ብዙኀ።
verses.translation: If thou wouldest get a friend, prove him first, and be not hasty to credit him.

translations.lxx: If thou wouldest get a friend, prove him first, and be not hasty to credit him.
translations.ron: Dacă vrei să-ţi faci un prieten, fă-l punându-l la încercare şi nu te grăbi să te încrezi în el.
translations.grk: Εἰ κτᾶσαι φίλον, ἐν πειρασμῷ κτῆσαι αὐτόν, καὶ μὴ ταχὺ ἐμπιστεύσῃς αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ቦ፡ ዐርክ፡ ኀላፊ፡ ወለኅዳጥ፡ መዋዕል፡ ውእቱ፡ ወኢይትዔገሥ፡ ምስሌከ፡ አመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ምንዳቤከ።
verses.translation: For some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of thy trouble.

translations.lxx: For some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of thy trouble.
translations.ron: Pentru că este prieten până la o vreme şi nu va rămâne în ziua necazului tău.
translations.grk: Ἔστι γὰρ φίλος ἐν καιρῷ αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐ μὴ παραμείνῃ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεώς σου.

verses.geez: ቦ፡ ዐርክ፡ ይከውነከ፡ ጸላዔ፡ ወይዘረክየከ፡ ወይከሥት፡ ለከ፡ ኅቡዓቲከ።
verses.translation: And there is a friend, who being turned to enmity and strife will discover thy reproach.

translations.lxx: And there is a friend, who being turned to enmity and strife will discover thy reproach.
translations.ron: Şi este prieten care se întoarce în duşman şi cearta dintre voi va da-o pe faţă, spre ocara ta.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔστι φίλος μετατιθέμενος εἰς ἔχθραν, καὶ μάχην ὀνειδισμοῦ σου ἀποκαλύψει.

verses.geez: ወቦ፡ ዐርክ፡ እንበይነ፡ ማዕድከ፡ ይትዐረከከ፡ ወውእቱኒ፡ ኢይደሉ፡ ምስሌከ፡ ወእም፡ ከመ፡ ተጸነስከ፡ የኀድገከ።
verses.translation: Again, some friend is a companion at the table, and will not continue in the day of thy affliction.

translations.lxx: Again, some friend is a companion at the table, and will not continue in the day of thy affliction.
translations.ron: Şi este prieten soţ de masă şi nu va rămâne lângă tine în ziua necazului tău.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔστι φίλος κοινωνὸς τραπεζῶν, καὶ οὐ μὴ παραμείνῃ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεώς σου.

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ትዴሎ፡ ይከውን፡ ከማከ፡ ወይኴንን፡ ነባሬከ።
verses.translation: But in thy prosperity he will be as thyself, and will be bold over thy servants.

translations.lxx: But in thy prosperity he will be as thyself, and will be bold over thy servants.
translations.ron: Şi în zilele cele bune ale tale va fi ca şi tine şi cu slugile tale va îndrăzni.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς σου ἔσται ὡς σὺ, καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς οἰκέτας σου παῤῥησιάσεται.

verses.geez: ወአመሰ፡ ተጸነስከ፡ ውእቱ፡ ይከውነከ፡ ዕድውከ፡ ወከመ፡ ኢትርአዮ፡ ይትኀብዐከ።
verses.translation: If thou be brought low, he will be against thee, and will hide himself from thy face.

translations.lxx: If thou be brought low, he will be against thee, and will hide himself from thy face.
translations.ron: Dar de te vei smeri, va fi împotriva ta şi de la faţa ta se va ascunde.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν ταπεινωθῇς, ἔσται κατὰ σοῦ, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ προσώπου σου κρυβήσεται.

verses.geez: ተገሐሥከ፡ እምጸላዕትከ፡ ወተዐቀቦሙ፡ ለአዕርክቲከ።
verses.translation: Separate thyself from thine enemies, and take heed of thy friends.

translations.lxx: Separate thyself from thine enemies, and take heed of thy friends.
translations.ron: Depărtează-te de duşmanii tăi şi fii cu pază faţă de prietenii tăi.
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου διαχωρίσθητι, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν φίλων σου πρόσεχε.

verses.geez: ዐርክ፡ ምእመን፡ ከመ፡ ወልታ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ወዘረከበ፡ ረከበ፡ መዝገበ።
verses.translation: A faithful friend is a strong defence: and he that hath found such an one hath found a treasure.

translations.lxx: A faithful friend is a strong defence: and he that hath found such an one hath found a treasure.
translations.ron: Prietenul credincios este acoperământ tare; şi cel ce l-a aflat pe el aflat-a comoară.
translations.grk: Φίλος πιστὸς σκέπη κραταιὰ, ὁ δὲ εὑρὼν αὐτὸν εὗρε θησαυρόν.

verses.geez: ለዐርክ፡ ምእመን፡ አልቦቱ፡ ተውላጥ፡ ወለልሳኑሂ፡ አልቦቱ፡ መድሎት።
verses.translation: Nothing doth countervail a faithful friend, and his excellency is invaluable.

translations.lxx: Nothing doth countervail a faithful friend, and his excellency is invaluable.
translations.ron: Cu prietenul credincios nimic nu se poate asemăna şi nu este măsură a bunătăţii lui.
translations.grk: Φίλου πιστοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν ἀντάλλαγμα, καὶ οὐκ ἔστι σταθμὸς τῆς καλλονῆς αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ዐርክ፡ ምእመን፡ ሥራየ፡ ሕይወት፡ ወእለ፡ ይፈርህዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ይረክብዎ።
verses.translation: A faithful friend is the medicine of life; and they that fear the Lord shall find him.

translations.lxx: A faithful friend is the medicine of life; and they that fear the Lord shall find him.
translations.ron: Prietenul credincios este leacul vieţii şi cei ce se tem de Domnul îl vor afla pe el.
translations.grk: Φίλος πιστὸς φάρμακον ζωῆς, καὶ οἱ φοβούμενοι Κύριον εὑρήσουσιν αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ዘይፈርሆ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ያረትዕ፡ ተአኃሁ፡ እስመ፡ ከማሁ፡ ይከውኖ፡ ቢጹሂ።
verses.translation: Whoso feareth the Lord shall direct his friendship aright: for as he is, so shall his neighbour be also.

translations.lxx: Whoso feareth the Lord shall direct his friendship aright: for as he is, so shall his neighbour be also.
translations.ron: Cel ce se teme de Domnul bine va ţine prieteşugul său, căci ca la sine ţine la aproapele lui.
translations.grk: Ὁ φοβούμενος Κύριον εὐθύνει φιλίαν αὐτοῦ, ὅτι κατʼ αὐτὸν οὕτως καὶ ὁ πλησίον αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ እምንእስከ፡ ኅረያ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ወእስከ፡ ትረሥዕ፡ ትረክባ።
verses.translation: My son, gather instruction from thy youth up: so shalt thou find wisdom till thine old age.

translations.lxx: My son, gather instruction from thy youth up: so shalt thou find wisdom till thine old age.
translations.ron: Fiule! Din tinereţile tale alege învăţătura şi până la cărunteţile tale vei afla înţelepciune.
translations.grk: Τέκνον, ἐκ νεότητός σου ἐπίλεξαι παιδείαν, καὶ ἕως πολιῶν εὑρήσεις σοφίαν.

verses.geez: ወፈር፡ ኀቤሃ፡ ከመ፡ ዘየሐርስ፡ ወከመ፡ ዘይዘርዕ፡ ወጽናሕ፡ ፍሬሃ፡ ቡሩክ፡ እስመ፡ ኅዳጠ፡ ትፃሙ፡ በቅኔሃ፡ ወፍጡነ፡ ትበልዕ፡ ቅምሐ።
verses.translation: Come unto her as one that ploweth and soweth, and wait for her good fruits: for thou shalt not toil much in labouring about her, but thou shalt eat of her fruits right soon.

translations.lxx: Come unto her as one that ploweth and soweth, and wait for her good fruits: for thou shalt not toil much in labouring about her, but thou shalt eat of her fruits right soon.
translations.ron: Ca şi cel ce ară şi seamănă, apropie-te de ea şi aşteaptă roadele ei cele bune.
translations.grk: Ὡς ὁ ἀροτριῶν καὶ ὁ σπείρων πρόσελθε αὐτῇ, καὶ ἀνάμενε τοὺς ἀγαθοὺς καρποὺς αὐτῆς· ἐν γὰρ τῇ ἐργασίᾳ αὐτῆς ὀλίγον κοπιάσεις, καὶ ταχὺ φάγεσαι γεννημάτων αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ፈድፋደ፡ መብዕስ፡ ይእቲ፡ በኀበ፡ አብዳን፡ ወበኀበ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ልብ፡ ኢትጐንዲ።
verses.translation: She is very unpleasant to the unlearned: he that is without understanding will not remain with her.

translations.lxx: She is very unpleasant to the unlearned: he that is without understanding will not remain with her.
translations.ron: Căci cu lucrarea ei puţin te vei osteni şi curând vei mânca roadele ei.
translations.grk: Ὡς τραχεῖά ἐστι σφόδρα τοῖς ἀπαιδεύτοις, καὶ οὐκ ἐμμενεῖ ἐν αὐτῇ ἀκάρδιος.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ዕብነ፡ መከራ፡ ሶበ፡ ያነሥእዎ፡ ከማሁ፡ ትከብድ፡ ወፍጡነ፡ ይገድፋ።
verses.translation: She will lie upon him as a mighty stone of trial; and he will cast her from him ere it be long.

translations.lxx: She will lie upon him as a mighty stone of trial; and he will cast her from him ere it be long.
translations.ron: Cât de grea este celor neînvăţaţi şi cel nepriceput nu va stărui în ea.
translations.grk: Ὡς λίθος δοκιμασίας ἰσχυρὸς ἔσται ἐπʼ αὐτῷ, καὶ οὐ χρονιεῖ ἀποῤῥίψαι αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ጥበብሰ፡ በከመ፡ ስማ፡ ይእቲ፡ ወአኮ፡ ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ የአምርዋ።
verses.translation: For wisdom is according to her name, and she is not manifest unto many.

translations.lxx: For wisdom is according to her name, and she is not manifest unto many.
translations.ron: Căci ea este pentru el ca o piatră grea de încercare, de aceea el nu va zăbovi s-o arunce.
translations.grk: Σοφία γὰρ κατὰ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς ἐστι, καὶ οὐ πολλοῖς ἐστι φανερά.

verses.geez: ስምዐኒ፡ ወልድየ፡ ወተዐገሥ፡ በምክርየ፡ ወኢታስትት፡ ተግሣጽየ።
verses.translation: Give ear, my son, receive my advice, and refuse not my counsel,

translations.lxx: Give ear, my son, receive my advice, and refuse not my counsel,
translations.ron: Că înţelepciunea îndreptăţeşte numele ei şi nu la mulţi este arătată.
translations.grk: Ἄκουσον, τέκνον, καὶ δέξαι γνώμην μου, καὶ μὴ ἀπαναίνου τὴν συμβουλίαν μου.

verses.geez: አብእ፡ እገሪከ፡ ውስተ፡ አርዑታ፡ ወዕንቅ፡ ውስተ፡ ክሣድከ፡ ጋጋሃ።
verses.translation: and put thy feet into her fetters, and thy neck into her chain.

translations.lxx: and put thy feet into her fetters, and thy neck into her chain.
translations.ron: Ascultă, fiule, şi primeşte învăţătura mea şi nu lepăda sfatul meu.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσένεγκον τοὺς πόδας σου εἰς τὰς πέδας αὐτῆς, καὶ εἰς τὸν κλοίον αὐτῆς τὸν τράχηλόν σου.

verses.geez: አትሕት፡ መታክፍቲከ፡ ወተሰከማ፡ ወኢትትቈጣዕ፡ በመዋቅሕቲሃ።
verses.translation: Bow down thy shoulder, and bear her, and be not grieved with her bonds.

translations.lxx: Bow down thy shoulder, and bear her, and be not grieved with her bonds.
translations.ron: Şi bagă picioarele tale în obezile ei şi în lanţul ei grumazul tău.
translations.grk: Ὑπόθες τὸν ὦμόν σοῦ, καὶ βάσταξον αὐτὴν, καὶ μὴ προσοχθίσῃς τοῖς δεσμοῖς αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወበኵሉ፡ ነፍስከ፡ ፈር፡ ኀቤሃ፡ ወበኵሉ፡ ኀይልከ፡ ዕቀብ፡ ፍናዊሃ።
verses.translation: Come unto her with thy whole heart, and keep her ways with all thy power.

translations.lxx: Come unto her with thy whole heart, and keep her ways with all thy power.
translations.ron: Încovoaie umărul tău şi o poartă pe ea şi să nu-ţi fie greu de legăturile ei.
translations.grk: Ἐν πάσῃ ψυχῇ σου πρόσελθε αὐτῇ, καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ δυνάμει σου συντήρησον τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ትሉ፡ ዓሠራ፡ ወኅሥሣ፡ ወትረክባ፡ አኀዛ፡ ወኢትኅድጋ።
verses.translation: Search, and seek, and she shall be made known unto thee: and when thou hast got hold of her, let her not go.

translations.lxx: Search, and seek, and she shall be made known unto thee: and when thou hast got hold of her, let her not go.
translations.ron: Cu tot sufletul tău apropie-te de ea şi cu toată puterea ta păzeşte căile ei.
translations.grk: Ἐξίχνεύσον καὶ ζήτησον, καὶ γνωσθήσεταί σοι, καὶ ἐγκρατὴς γενόμενος μὴ ἀφῇς αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ወበደኃሪትከ፡ ትረክብ፡ ዕረፍተ፡ ወትፍሥሕተ፡ ይከውነከ።
verses.translation: For at the last thou shalt find her rest, and that shall be turned to thy joy.

translations.lxx: For at the last thou shalt find her rest, and that shall be turned to thy joy.
translations.ron: Cearcă-o şi o caută şi ţi se va arăta şi, dacă o vei afla, să nu o laşi.
translations.grk: Ἐπʼ ἐσχάτων γὰρ εὑρήσεις τὴν ἀνάπαυσιν αὐτῆς, καὶ στραφήσεταί σοι εἰς εὐφροσύνην.

verses.geez: ወመዋቅሕቲሃኒ፡ ከመ፡ ወልታ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ይከውነከ፡ ወጋጋሃኒ፡ አልባሰ፡ ክብር፡ ይገብአከ።
verses.translation: Then shall her fetters be a strong defence for thee, and her chains a robe of glory.

translations.lxx: Then shall her fetters be a strong defence for thee, and her chains a robe of glory.
translations.ron: Că mai pe urmă vei afla odihna ei şi ţi se va întoarce întru bucurie.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσονταί σοι αἱ πέδαι εἰς σκέπην ἰσχύος, καὶ οἱ κλοιοὶ αὐτῆς εἰς στολὴν δόξης.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ዘለዓለመ፡ ወርቅ፡ ኀቤሃ፡ ሀሎ፡ ወመዓሥርቲሃኒ፡ ሠርጐ፡ ያክንት፡ ይከውነከ።
verses.translation: For there is a golden ornament upon her, and her bands are purple lace.

translations.lxx: For there is a golden ornament upon her, and her bands are purple lace.
translations.ron: Şi îţi vor fi obezile ei acoperământ de tărie şi lanţurile ei podoabă de mărire.
translations.grk: Κόσμος γὰρ χρύσεός ἐστιν ἐπʼ αὐτῆς, καὶ οἱ δεσμοὶ αὐτῆς κλῶσμα ὑακίνθινον.

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ልብሰ፡ ክብር፡ ትለብሳ፡ ወአክሊለ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ ታስተቈጽለከ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt put her on as a robe of honour, and shalt put her about thee as a crown of joy.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt put her on as a robe of honour, and shalt put her about thee as a crown of joy.
translations.ron: Că podoabă de aur este în ea şi legăturile ei fire de iachint.
translations.grk: Στολὴν δόξης ἐνδύσῃ αὐτὴν, καὶ στέφανον ἀγαλλιάματος περιθήσεις σεαυτῷ.

verses.geez: ለእመ፡ ትፈቅድ፡ ወልድየ፡ ትጠበብ፡ ወለእመ፡ አጥባዕከ፡ እምነፍስከ፡ ከመ፡ ትትመሀር።
verses.translation: My son, if thou wilt, thou shalt be taught: and if thou wilt apply thy mind, thou shalt be prudent.

translations.lxx: My son, if thou wilt, thou shalt be taught: and if thou wilt apply thy mind, thou shalt be prudent.
translations.ron: Ca şi cu haină de mărire te vei îmbrăca cu ea şi cunună de bucurie îţi vei pune.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν θέλῃς, τέκνον, παιδευθήσῃ, καὶ ἐὰν δῷς τὴν ψυχήν σου, πανοῦργος ἔσῃ.

verses.geez: ወለእመ፡ ትፈቱ፡ ትስማዕ፡ ተዐገሥ፡ ወለእመ፡ አጽማዕከ፡ እዘኒከ፡ ትስማዕ፡ ጥበበ።
verses.translation: If thou love to hear, thou shalt receive understanding: and if thou bow thine ear, thou shalt be wise.

translations.lxx: If thou love to hear, thou shalt receive understanding: and if thou bow thine ear, thou shalt be wise.
translations.ron: De vei vrea, fiule, vei învăţa şi, de vei pune sufletul tău, iscusit vei fi.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν ἀγαπήσῃς ἀκούειν ἐκδέξῃ, καὶ ἐὰν κλίνῃς τὸ οὖς σου σοφὸς ἔσῃ.

verses.geez: ኀበ፡ ብዙኃን፡ አዕሩግ፡ ቁም፡ ወዘርኢከ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ፡ ጠቢበ፡ ትልዎ።
verses.translation: Stand in the multitude of the elders; and cleave unto him that is wise.

translations.lxx: Stand in the multitude of the elders; and cleave unto him that is wise.
translations.ron: De-ţi va plăcea să asculţi, vei învăţa şi de vei pleca urechea ta, înţelept vei fi.
translations.grk: Ἐν πλήθει πρεσβυτέρων στῆθι, καὶ, τίς σοφός; αὐτῷ προσκολλήθητι.

verses.geez: ወኵሎ፡ ነገረ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ አፍጥን፡ ለሰሚዕ፡ ወምሳሌ፡ ጥበብኒ፡ ኢይትረሣዕከ።
verses.translation: Be willing to hear every godly discourse: and let not the parables of understanding escape thee.

translations.lxx: Be willing to hear every godly discourse: and let not the parables of understanding escape thee.
translations.ron: Stai în tovărăşia celor bătrâni şi cu cel înţelept te uneşte.
translations.grk: Πᾶσαν διήγησιν θείαν θέλε ἀκούειν, καὶ παροιμίαι συνέσεως μὴ ἐκφευγέτωσάν σε.

verses.geez: ወለእመኒ፡ ርኢከ፡ ጠቢበ፡ ጊሥ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ወመድረከ፡ ኆኅቱ፡ ያንዛሕልል፡ ሰኰናሁ።
verses.translation: And if thou seest a man of understanding, get thee betimes unto him, and let thy foot wear the steps of his door.

translations.lxx: And if thou seest a man of understanding, get thee betimes unto him, and let thy foot wear the steps of his door.
translations.ron: Tot graiul dumnezeiesc pofteşte a-l auzi şi pildele înţelegerii să nu treacă de la tine.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν ἴδῃς συνετὸν, ὄρθριζε πρὸς αὐτὸν, καὶ βαθμοὺς θυρῶν αὐτοῦ ἐκτριβέτω ὁ πούς σου.

verses.geez: ሐሊ፡ ትእዛዞ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወአንብብ፡ መጻሕፍቲሁ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ያጸንዐከ፡ ልበከ፡ ወይሁበከ፡ ታፍቅራ፡ ለጥበብ።
verses.translation: Let thy mind be upon the ordinances of the Lord, and meditate continually in his commandments: he shall establish thine heart, and give thee wisdom at thine own desire.

translations.lxx: Let thy mind be upon the ordinances of the Lord, and meditate continually in his commandments: he shall establish thine heart, and give thee wisdom at thine own desire.
translations.ron: De vei vedea înţelept, intră la el şi pragurile uşilor lui să le roadă piciorul tău.
translations.grk: Διανοοῦ ἐν τοῖς προστάγμασιν Κυρίου, καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς αὐτοῦ μελέτα διαπαντός· αὐτὸς στηριεῖ τὴν καρδίαν σου, καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῆς σοφίας σου δοθήσεταί σοι.
